overview_description.description:
Atlar helps modern finance teams manage money. Customers like Aiven, Acne Studios, GetYourGuide, Forto, Juni, and Liberis use Atlar to unify financial data, analyze cash flow, and manage payments in real time – all in one platform.

Finance tooling is overdue an upgrade, but uprooting legacy technology requires a new approach. We're changing the way businesses manage money – and helping finance teams do the heavy lifting that keeps our companies and economies running.

Atlar is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, and backed by Index Ventures, investors in category defining companies such as Adyen, Revolut, Figma, and more.

product.name: Cash Management
product.description: A platform feature that consolidates bank and ERP data to provide real-time visibility and control over company-wide cash positions and liquidity.

product.name: Payments
product.description: A centralized system to approve, sign, monitor, and reconcile payments across banks, payment providers, and ERPs, supporting multiple currencies and payment schemes.

product.name: Cash Flow Forecasting
product.description: An automated forecasting tool that combines and normalizes bank, ERP, and file data to create dynamic cash flow forecasts with scenario planning and variance analysis.

product.name: Bank and ERP Connectivity
product.description: Managed, high-performing integrations with banks, payment providers, and ERP systems using APIs, SFTP, EBICS, and other protocols for real-time data exchange.

product.name: Investment Management Integration with TreasurySpring
product.description: An embedded integration allowing users to manage and invest surplus cash in TreasurySpring’s fixed-term funds directly within the Atlar platform.
